 AUSTIN, Texas - A trip to H-E-B turned into a million-dollar payday for one lucky San Antonio resident who claimed a $1 million top prize playing a Texas Lottery scratch-off game.
 The winning Casino Millions ticket was purchased at H-E-B Food Store #235, located at 9255 Grissom Road on the Northwest Side.
 The winner chose to remain anonymous.
 The H-E-B location could also be in line for a payday. Under the Texas Lottery's Retailer Bonus Program, the store may be eligible for a $10,000 bonus for selling the winning ticket.
 This marks the third of four $1 million top prizes claimed in the Casino Millions game, leaving just one top prize remaining.
 The scratch-off game offers more than $195.3 million in total prizes, with overall odds of winning any prize at one in 3.45. Those odds include prizes that simply return the cost of the ticket.
